components.intent: Organize the clinic as a compact single-level hub with three distinct program wings.
Receive occupants from the primary approach and feed them northward into the consultation hub.
Provide the central consultation space that distributes movement toward treatment and support wings.
Provide treatment space directly adjacent to the consultation hub in a perpendicular north wing.
Place staff and service support in an east wing separated from the public reception volume.

constraint_responses.rationale: The proposal establishes a 1,200-square-metre gross footprint but preserves net area as unresolved because no bounded allocation among functions is supplied.
The consultation hub and treatment wing share an edge and are represented by a matching undirected connection.
The south reception wing meets the consultation hub and is represented by a directed reception-to-consultation connection.
The support wing branches east from the consultation hub and has no shared edge or direct connection with the south reception wing.

proposal.label: Three-wing clinical hub
proposal.rationale: This independent alternative forms a bent three-wing hub near the site anchor. Reception extends toward the declared southern approach, consultation becomes the central distributor, treatment turns north, and staff-service support branches east. The branching topology differs materially from the excluded four-band linear sequence while retaining the declared circulation, adjacency, separation, and footprint requirements at schematic resolution.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A compact single-storey clinic can use consultation as a central distributing hub, with reception, treatment, and staff-service functions occupying perpendicular wings rather than consecutive linear bands.

components.intent: Organize the clinic as one compact, single-level schematic assembly aligned with the declared primary approach.
Receive arriving occupants and establish the start of the public clinical sequence.
Provide consultation space directly after reception and adjacent to treatment.
Provide treatment space contiguous with consultation while remaining distinct in the component tree.
Concentrate staff and service support at the end of the massing sequence, apart from reception.

constraint_responses.rationale: The 1,200-square-metre gross footprint is bounded by the declared range, but net area remains unresolved because no room-area allocation is supplied.
Consultation and treatment occupy immediately adjacent massing bands and are joined by an undirected connection.
A directed connection leads from reception and waiting to consultation.
Reception and staff-service support occupy opposite ends of the four-band massing sequence, with consultation and treatment between them.

existing_option_projection.label: Compact linear clinic sequence
existing_option_projection.rationale: The option places a 1,200-square-metre footprint around the site anchor and near the declared primary approach. Its linear ordering expresses the required reception-to-consultation sequence, preserves consultation-treatment adjacency, and separates reception from staff-service support at coarse massing resolution.
existing_option_projection.typology_hypothesis: A compact single-storey bar clinic uses four consecutive program bands, placing the public entry sequence first, clinical functions centrally, and staff-service support at the remote end.

alternative_context.instructions: Author a complete independent alternative with a new option_id and meaningfully different spatial topology. Do not rename, patch, or select the existing option.

payload.instructions: Author one schematic option from only the supplied current records. Create the existing DesignComponent tree and its coarse massing volumes in the same proposal. Every volume must have exactly one component owner. Preserve project evidence references and return only the required output object; do not select, persist, execute, or claim validation.

component_geometry_invariants: components form exactly one rooted acyclic tree
every volume id exists and is owned by exactly one component
component and volume source refs are present in evidence_refs
proposal authority fields equal proposal_fixed_values exactly

item_exact_fields.unresolved_child_roles: array of local-id strings; empty allowed
item_exact_fields.volume_ids: array of local-id strings; empty allowed

exact_fields.maximum: exactly [integer x, integer y, integer z]
exact_fields.minimum: exactly [integer x, integer y, integer z]

assumptions.statement: The numeric ranges are direct user-declared experiment inputs, preserved as bounded values rather than point defaults.

obligations.statement: Derive bounded net-area hypotheses or preserve net area as unknown.

scenarios.label: Whole-building declared capacity and area envelope

reference_contract.nested_source_rule: every nested source_ref must also appear in proposal.evidence_refs

repair_feedback.diagnostic: SpatialCompilationError: proposal cites evidence absent from the current design state
repair_feedback.instructions: Return one complete replacement output satisfying the unchanged contracts. Do not return a patch and do not reuse invalid fields.

required_invariants: program_scenario_ref names a current program scenario
footprint_range_ref names a compatible current footprint range
footprint area equals len(footprint_cells) multiplied by grid_basis.horizontal_area_per_cell
footprint area is within the cited footprint range and uses the same area_unit
every footprint cell x/z lies inside the observed site envelope
every level spans inclusive y from base_y through base_y + height - 1 inside the site envelope
every volume bound lies inside the site envelope and names only current level_ids
for each volume include every inclusive [x,z] pair from bounds.minimum through bounds.maximum in footprint_cells
each volume projection contains at most 4096 inclusive x/z cells
each named level is vertically contained by its volume bounds
every current function_ref appears in exactly one zone and no other program_node_ref is used
every zone names only declared level_ids and volume_ids
each connection joins zones containing its relationship source and target nodes and matches relationship directed exactly
every required response ref is covered by a constraint_response or a matching connection relationship_ref
